modelRepository.licensingAmbiguity: The converted-weight repository declares Apache-2.0 and supplies LICENSE and NOTICE. Its NOTICE reports that the upstream DepthART project repository lacks a LICENSE file or copyright notice and relies on Apache-2.0 metadata declared by the upstream model host.

demoImage.processing: Byte-identical copy; original file not modified.
demoImage.embeddedMetadata: No EXIF, XMP, or IPTC tags detected; JFIF with a 12-byte 8BIM profile.
demoImage.rightsNote: The user confirmed ownership and directed inclusion in the public repository. Copyright remains with the photograph owner; the MIT code licence does not apply and no standalone reuse licence is granted.

demoMirrorStudy.scope: Fixed mask for the bundled bathroom image only; never applied to uploads or camera frames.
demoMirrorStudy.interpretation: Artistic screen-space approximation, not semantic mirror detection, physical refraction, scene reconstruction, or optical ray tracing.

outputSemantics: Nonnegative affine-invariant relative disparity at 448 by 448; not metric depth and not a real-world distance measurement.
privacyBoundary: All photograph and camera-frame processing remains in the browser. The preview does not upload or retain photographs.
